name: context7-docs
title_zh: 每次回答前先查最新官方文档的库说明书
tagline_zh: 训练数据里的 API 早过期了。问 React、Prisma 还是 Spring Boot。
tagline_en: Your training data is stale. Ask about React, Prisma, or Spring Boot—it pulls current docs first, then answers.
desc_en: Fetch up-to-date documentation and code examples for any library, framework, SDK, CLI tool, or cloud service. Use whenever the user asks about a specific library — even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot — because training data may not reflect recent API changes or version updates. Always use for: API syntax questions, configuration options, vers
why_zh: 机制上把「检索」放在「生成」之前，且检索源是官方仓库而非二手博客。版本变更、废弃参数、新语法。
why_en: Retrieval precedes generation, pulling from official repos—not blogs. Version bumps, deprecations, new syntax: it always knows.
limit_zh: 只覆盖公开文档能查到的内容；私有仓库、未发布版本、需登录的文档查不到。回答质量依赖网络连通，离线时退化为普通模型记忆。
limit_en: Only public docs; no private repos, unreleased versions, or login-walled pages. Needs network—offline it degrades to plain model memory.
title_en: Fetches live official docs before answering any library.
